notes: Scan 022 reuses preprinted official letterhead for autograph mathematics. The printed text has three lines, with two horizontal rules, and is retained without adding French accents. The dark authorial number is 4 inside a broad curve open at the top; light foliation 21 is separate at the lower left. No date is written.

The original was viewed once for layout, then exactly two native-resolution halves were made and each viewed once: [0,0,1682,1298] and [0,1062,1682,2360]. Sixteen tight crops were made and all sixteen were actually viewed. Every block, tuple coordinate, exponent, delimiter, arrow end, relation, margin note and alteration was read against both witnesses. No other pages or reports, OCR, external research or TeX compilation were used.

Line count 44 counts the physical text/formula rows, with continuous rows of side-by-side formulas counted once and separately positioned marginal rows counted separately. It includes the three printed lines, the two number positions, the factor-annotation row and the smaller added equality; diagram arrow labels and frame strokes are not counted as additional text lines. The inventory provides the full reading scope. The tall case brace spans the three cases, with the j=1 reasoning extending between its j=1 and j=2 rows.

The three live group signs remain G|S, with G ranked first from their enclosing stroke, interior loop/bar and upper hook. The cancelled opening sign remains doubtful as well. The point-symbol family throughout remains zeta|xi; isolated primes are preserved independently and no obscured prime is supplied from the calculation.

The top second group enumeration has an opening curly brace but closes with a round parenthesis. That unmatched form is clear and retained. The right closures of the rho-squared coordinate output and of the bottom p-rho-d-sigma argument are angular; both receive the same ]|) doubt because a squared parenthesis ductus is also possible.

The upper diagram’s membership signs open upward: they are represented with in rotated +90, not C’s ni rotated +90. Under the factorization braces, the same vertical membership is clear above h and doubtful above g where it meets the letter’s loop. The long bars and labels remain vertical; no horizontal equation is substituted.

The five identities are inside a single drawn enclosure with gaps at both upper corners and a doubled/traced right edge. The frame is reproduced with TikZ strokes; every equation and written word remains an actual LaTeX text/math node, with no glyph paths. The constant-map label is an open-right c, distinct from nearby closed-eye e forms. Its application constante de valeur e_2 phrase stays beside it inside the frame. The clear circled star is inside; the additional loop/cross is placed at the right boundary as a doubtful circled-star candidate overlapped by the edge strokes. Connected border-return geometry remains possible, and no deletion state is asserted.

The sigma_i squared relation is an addition whose curved leader ends between rho^3=1 and the conjugacy relation. The exceptional ou condition above the criterion attaches to its right-hand side. The first implication has a question mark; the opposite implication and the vertical equivalent-equality connection remain explicit.

Below e_3 in the j=1 argument are two distinct parallel upright strokes and the smaller added d(point-prime)=d(e_2). This is vertical equality, not a double prime on d. The live following donc d(point)=e_3 donc is distinct from the next cancelled repetition. The strike crosses only donc d(point)=e_3; the projection chain below it remains live.

M0838 is resolved to joined cqfd, without C’s completed internal periods. Every deleted prime and the deleted factor remain doubtful because their underlying strokes are not fully recoverable. Heavier retracing in d, rho-squared and some point symbols is not assigned an invented earlier letter.

H’s editorial headings, prose synopses, notes and narrative connectives are excluded from source and correction counts. Its mathematical content is still compared against each written formula; alignment jumps caused by its rearranged case list do not create invented omissions. All 104 literal-tab difference rows have an explicit disposition.

Refined statement 151.022.coordinate-compositions: if the displayed coordinate rules are composed as ordinary maps, then pd(x,y)=(x,y), p rho d(x,y)=(y,y), and p rho^2 d(x,y)=(y,x). These direct substitutions were checked. The boxed claim p rho d=c of fixed value e_2 therefore requires those diagonal values to represent e_2, or an abstract setting different from unrestricted ordered pairs. The page may be changing settings, so no unconditional contradiction is asserted and neither source formula is emended.

Second-reading boxes 4, 10, 11, 13 and 15 extend slightly beyond their corresponding tight first-pass crop bounds to include full label tops/descenders and neighbouring context for the future reader. These are only box specifications; no additional first-pass images were created or viewed.

Root-requested frame correction: the source upper corner gaps and doubled right edge are now explicit in the drawing. This is a diplomatic shape correction against C as well as H; it adds no mathematical consequence or new source text. The existing p07 evidence was sufficient; no new crop or image view was made.
